data.current_summary: Data for one card of a custom dashboard
data.current_description: Returns the live data of one card of a custom dashboard. Dashboards are lists of cards (see dashboards_get for the card list) and each card loads separately, so call this once per card with its position in index, counted from 0. Returns index, type, title, site_id, site_name, params, status and data. status is ok, not_available (the card has nothing to show, for example a funnel card on a site with no funnels or an uptime card with no checks) or no_access (the card belongs to a site your token or role cannot open, and then title, params and data are empty). The shape of data depends on type. metric gives {metric, value, previous, change, period} compared with the previous period. chart gives {metric, interval, period, series: [{date, value}]}. breakdown gives {dimension, label, rows}. goal gives {rows} of goal completions. live gives {visitors}. funnel gives {funnel_id, name, overall_conversion_rate, steps}. uptime gives {checks: [{name, status, uptime}]}. vitals gives {scorecard}. subscriptions gives {currency, mrr_minor, previous_mrr_minor (30 days ago), change (percent, null without MRR 30 days ago), active_subscriptions, subscription_churn_rate (last 30 days)} and is not_available while the site has no payment provider connected. Returns index, type, title, site_id, site_name, params, status and data. status is ok, not_available (the card has nothing to show, for example a funnel card on a site with no funnels or an uptime card with no checks) or no_access (the card belongs to a site your token or role cannot open, and then title, params and data are empty).
